_comment: MViewer performance budget — single source of truth for `mviewer_bench --enforce --budget`. Each entry in `scenario_map` (B1-B9 + B11-B15) is a HARD gate: if the scenario's measured metric exceeds its `budgets` limit, the run FAILS (exit 1) and the PR is blocked. Lower-is-better for all latency/memory metrics; cache_hit_rate/cache_hit_ratio/thumbnails_per_sec/baseline_return_ok are higher-is-better (see mviewer::bench::Budget::higherIsBetter in src/benchmark/main.cpp). B0/B10/TRACE are intentionally report-only; B10 is still +/-10% regression-checked when --regression is given. The limits are generous, cross-machine-STABLE absolute caps, so the mandatory CI hard gate (perf-gate.yml) never fails on CI hardware jitter (product力 #2 '稳得住'). Regression-vs-baseline (perf_baseline.json) is a SEPARATE, noisier axis run via --regression in nightly.yml, NOT part of the mandatory CI gate.
